name: neo-brutalist-craft
title: Neo Brutalist Craft
description: Intentional ink borders, offset hard shadows, bold geometric contrast, and strict spacing discipline rather than chaotic brutalist decoration.

typography.fontFamily: Arial Black, Archivo Black, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
typography.monospaceFamily: IBM Plex Mono, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace
typography.displayFamily: Arial Black, Archivo Black, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

rules: Use bold ink borders and offset hard shadows intentionally, with one consistent light direction.
Anchor every element to the four-pixel grid; chaos in content never excuses chaos in spacing.
Choose one loud accent per composition and keep surrounding surfaces quiet.
Display type is bold and geometric; body copy switches to a readable system sans when needed.
Use square or small radii for surfaces and reserve pills for tags and compact actions.
Press feedback translates elements toward their hard shadow without changing layout.
Use asymmetric editorial or bento compositions instead of repeated centered cards.
All text and controls meet contrast requirements despite high-chroma accents.
Icons are geometric, consistent, and labelled; emoji are not a substitute for illustration.
Reduced-motion mode removes translation while preserving border, color, and pressed-state feedback.
